about: Discord #2: a captive carried by hobgoblins (transfer cage) must not exist twice after a save and reload, right after loading or once the restored transfers go on. gnx_scn_tag_captives numbers every captive once (the number is saved with her); gnx_scn_dup_captives looks for a number in two cells, cages, prison slots or the raid cage.

steps.why: transfers running

steps.name: gnx_scn_dup_captives
steps.why: control: no captive twice before any reload
odd intervals so saves land in different transfer phases
